# STX Next

> > STX Next is an AI-powered global IT consulting leader specializing in Python development, cloud solutions, data engineering, and machine learning services.

STX Next is a comprehensive software development and consulting company offering end-to-end services from product design through deployment. With deep expertise in Python, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML, and data engineering, they serve enterprise clients globally with a focus on modern technologies and scalable solutions.

## Key Topics

- Python Development
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Cloud Architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Data Engineering & Lakehouse
- Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Microsoft Fabric & Snowflake
- MLOps & Computer Vision
- Product Development
- Cloud Migration
- Web & Mobile Development
- Design Services & UX
- Quality Assurance
- Predictive Maintenance
- FinOps & Cost Optimization
- Data Analytics & Visualization

- [AI Development Services](https://www.stxnext.com/services/artificial-intelligence): AI development: LLMs, generative AI, RAG, machine learning solutions

- [Amazon Bedrock Consulting & Development Services](https://www.stxnext.com/services/amazon-bedrock-consulting-development-services): Amazon Bedrock: AI agents, autonomous systems, AWS GenAI solutions
